prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
(none yet)

(not available)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 83.0%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 92.7%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 73.1%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 93.6%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 76.1%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 40.1%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [adoption, new_screen] Pet Customization Trait Selector Screen: Adds a dedicated trait selection screen right after picking a friend to customize pet personality traits, visual palette, and sound options before generating the certificate. (why: Adoption conversion drops to 73.1% and support received 3 tickets regarding custom pet generation visual failures; explicit trait confirmation reduces generation errors and increases user attachment.)
1: [choose_path, reorder] Narrative Story Intro Screen Reorder: Reorders the onboarding sequence to lead with an engaging story scroll screen before path choice, helping set expectations before forcing a decision. (why: 17% of users drop off at choose_path with a high mean time of 514s, indicating confusion or hesitation when choosing a path without story context.)
2: [sign_in, hint] Account Pet Preservation Safeguard Hint: Displays an explicit account persistence hint during sign-in, explaining that logging in locks pet data to cloud storage to prevent pet resets across app updates. (why: Support received 8 emails—the largest issue group—reporting pets missing or reset after signing in again.)
3: [adoption, hint] Custom Photo Upload Lighting Requirement Hint: Adds a clear photo requirement hint banner on the upload step emphasizing bright lighting, single subject focus, and front-facing angles. (why: 3 support emails reported custom pet generation failures or distorted custom pet renders during adoption.)
4: [home, notification] Desktop Spawn Completion Audio Alert Toggle: Enables an explicit audio chime switch and desktop notification toggle on the waiting screen so users know when their pet finishes loading. (why: Home wait time has a high mean duration of 2336s (median 201s), showing users step away or minimize while waiting for pet creation.)

scores.note: Targets the high-drop adoption step, but adding a full new screen increases friction.
Addresses high hesitation time at choose_path by providing story context first.
Addresses the largest support ticket volume (8 emails) with a simple hint config.
Combines worst funnel drop step with support evidence; low cost hint with high lift potential.
Helps re-engage users stepping away during long background home spawn times.
